facts.fact: Chad's Presidency communications directorate (DGCOM/PR) said on 24 November 2025 that manipulating the President's image, including AI deepfakes, is formally banned and will be prosecuted under existing law on false information or deceptive content (deepfakes) and digital identity usurpation; no new instrument is named.
